A rank signal = "keep: this rank is needed, do not discard" (info only). Hmm, simpler: a signal to a seat on the rank of their slot means play it now if it's lit-able. (2) Only discard when crew has <6 signals and the card is surely dead (its tower already past it). (3) Play only cards we know are the next rank; never misfire blindly. (4) Oldest-first: when signalled, play the slot the signal touched that is lowest-numbered. Please reply if you disagree.

I'm reviewing game 2 and noticing that I discarded a lot — ten times — partly to fish for signals, and partly because my hand was stuck. Those discards handed back information, and the crew tended to get rid of the 5s, 6s, and 7s early.

I'm working out a new team brain: signals should mean play now only when the target slot is playable on every candidate tower, and discards should be limited to truly dead cards, since a lost 4, 5 or 6 can stall a whole tower. I also need to recheck my slot knowledge after each play, because the slots shift.

text:
I'm going to send the team my view in a short message. The main lessons are that discards cost cards, and that I made a few discard mistakes, including keeping a Violet 6 that was still live. I also noticed that telling teammates which cards are playable right now worked well, and that late in the game a signal can point at the holder once everyone else is out of cards. I'm also starting to think about one more signal.

I'm weighing whether a card-less seat can get a signal at all, since signals just drain the team's options. Then I'll decide whether to ask the captain to write the brain note, or to post my view and suggest a concrete note myself, while keeping the number of posts small.

args.text: A04 retro, game 2 (23 lit). Agree with A01 on the core: discards of unproven cards cost us most. My two worst: Cobalt 4 (not provably dead, discarded for a signal) and Violet 6 (I misjudged it as dead; Violet 2-5 were still open). What worked: play-now signals (rank 1, "Moss" touching a playable Moss 2, rank 3, "5", "4") each unlocked a lit card. Proposed v3 wording: (a) rank/suit signal touching a card playable now on every tower it could be = play lowest touched slot. (b) Signal on an unplayable card = keep, no play/discard. (c) Discard only if a card is provably dead: rank below the tower's next with that rank already lost, or tower passed it. Count the lost ranks before discarding. (d) Late game, a seat with no cards can only give signals: use them to name our remaining cards by rank (3, 4, 7) so the holder plays the right slot.
